nav.dashboard.desc: Sidebar link to the dashboard (Alt+1). It opens the start page with the assigned game, today's gaming budget and the quick actions.

nav.backlog.desc: Sidebar link to the backlog page (Alt+2). It opens the planner, the completion-time stats and the full game list.

nav.picks.desc: Sidebar link to the picks page (Alt+3). It opens check, done, pick and scan, plus your manual picks.

nav.gaming.desc: Sidebar link to the gaming page (Alt+4). It opens the daily gaming budget with its reset, block and unblock actions.

nav.library.desc: Sidebar link to the library page (Alt+5). It opens every game you own, with install, uninstall and hide.

nav.store.desc: Sidebar link to the store page (Alt+6). It opens the timed store unblock, buying DLC and game exceptions.

nav.jobs.desc: Sidebar link to the jobs page (Alt+7). It lists the running and past jobs with their logs.

nav.system.desc: Sidebar link to the system page (Alt+8). It opens the root daemon, the web server, state backups, reset and setup.

palette.open.desc: Top-bar button (Ctrl+K) that opens the command palette. There you search for any command or section and run or open it.

cmd.status.desc: Opens the current status: the assigned game, its achievement progress and the enforcer's state.

cmd.list.desc: Opens the game list from the last scan snapshot, with achievements and completion times.

cmd.stats.desc: Opens the backlog estimates: how long the remaining games take to finish at your pace.

cmd.installed.desc: Opens the list of games installed on this PC, with the assigned and protected ones marked.

cmd.gaming-status.desc: Opens today's gaming time: minutes used, budget left and whether gaming is blocked.

cmd.check.desc: Runs check: looks for a new achievement on the assigned game. One new achievement releases the game.

cmd.scan.desc: Runs scan: reads the achievements of every owned game and assigns a game when none is set.

cmd.done.desc: Runs done: confirms a new achievement on the assigned game and moves on to pick the next one.

cmd.pick.desc: Runs pick: offers other candidate games to play next. It keeps the current game unless told to replace it.

cmd.pick-manual.desc: Runs a manual pick: you choose a game by hand and the enforcer locks onto it for some days.

cmd.abandon-pick.desc: Runs abandon pick: undoes a manual pick, so the enforcer assigns a game again.

cmd.install.desc: Runs install: downloads an allowed game, trying the fast installer first.

cmd.uninstall.desc: Runs uninstall: removes every installed game that is neither assigned nor protected.

cmd.hide.desc: Runs hide: hides every game except the assigned one in the Steam library.

cmd.unhide.desc: Runs unhide: shows every game in the Steam library again.

cmd.buy-dlc.desc: Runs buy DLC: unblocks the Steam store for 15 minutes so you can buy a game or DLC.

cmd.unblock.desc: Runs unblock: opens the Steam store for a number of minutes, at most 30.

cmd.add-exception.desc: Runs add exception: allows one game right away, after a typed phrase and a logged reason.

cmd.block-gaming.desc: Runs block gaming: blocks all gaming for a number of days. There is no undo in the app.

cmd.reset.desc: Runs reset: wipes all enforcer state after saving a timestamped backup.

cmd.setup.desc: Opens setup: the Steam API key and the SteamID the enforcer needs.

cmd.enforce.desc: Runs the enforcer: block, uninstall, kill and hide. The demo runs a 60-second gaming budget only.

cmd.gaming-reset.desc: Runs gaming reset: resets today's gaming counter as root, after a typed phrase and a five-minute countdown.

cmd.gaming-unblock.desc: Runs gaming unblock: force-releases the playtime bind mounts. It is the root recovery hatch.

cmd.serve.desc: Restarts this web UI server. It comes back on the current code by itself.

cmd.restore-backup.desc: Restores a saved state backup after you type its phrase.

job.state.queued.desc: Job state badge: the job waits to start.

job.state.running.desc: Job state badge: the job is running now.

job.state.waiting_input.desc: Job state badge: the job is paused on a question and needs your answer.

job.state.succeeded.desc: Job state badge: the job finished without errors.

job.state.failed.desc: Job state badge: the job stopped on an error. Its log says why.

job.state.cancelled.desc: Job state badge: the job was stopped before it finished.

notice.info.desc: Mark on an information notice: a neutral fact or a hint.

notice.success.desc: Mark on a success notice: the action worked.

notice.warning.desc: Mark on a warning notice: something needs your attention, but nothing failed.

notice.danger.desc: Mark on an error notice: something failed or was refused. The server's message follows it.
